overview: You faired the dawn that was already written, down to the line of the woes, and you left a cross in the margin. You did not write finished. You kept the bundle on the other side of the board from the private verse.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Faired the lines and left the rehearsal mark where it was needed.

key_provisions.text: the two piles on the board
